mapper.select: SELECT c.cate_code, c.cate_prtcode, c.cate_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_tbl p WHERE p.cate_code = c.cate_code) AS pro_count FROM cate_tbl c ORDER BY c.cate_prtcode NULLS FIRST, c.cate_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cate_tbl(cate_code, cate_prtcode, cate_name) SELECT NVL(MAX(cate_code), 0) + 1, #{cate_prtcode, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{cate_name} FROM cate_tbl
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cate_tbl WHERE cate_prtcode = #{cate_code}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_tbl WHERE cate_code = #{cate_code}
